coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: WU Ch'ung-yüeh 伍崇曜 (T. 良輔, H. 紫垣, original ming 元薇), Mar. 9, 1810–1863, Dec. 2, a native of Canton, was the fifth son of the famous Hong merchant, Wu Ping-chien [q. v.]. Like his father, he was known to Westerners as Howqua.
